machineId.note: Patent publication identity, not a surviving-machine identifier.

name.note: Contract name distinguishes the patent topology from every engine prototype.

source.value: US3890548A Pulsed capacitor discharge electric engine
source.note: The publication describes topology and sequence but does not dimension a build replica.

engineModel.note: The patent topology is not one of the six engine prototype catalog rows.

topology.note: This is the publication topology represented by the illustrative FEM assembly.

geometryRevision.note: All dimensions are illustrative modeling assumptions, not patent manufacturing dimensions.

windingTurns.note: The homogenized winding is a numerical source proxy and not a documented patent winding.

excitationEventSchedule.note: The angular sequence follows the publication; the FEM case samples static states and does not simulate switching.

materials.note: Constant linear material values are reproducibility assumptions only.

circuit.note: The current FEM case contains no capacitor, commutator, conversion tube, or recovery circuit.

mechanicalLoad.note: No inertia, friction, shaft load, or dynamic rotor equation exists in the magnetostatic case.

femAvailability.note: Compatibility means this contract identifies the current illustrative case; it does not claim a replica, solver result, or historical validation.

limitations.note: Geometry scale, materials, winding, and excitation magnitude are modeling assumptions.
No solver output is bundled or claimed by this machine contract.
